answer: An operator running 298 keys hence pays for 298 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the copper quota and the cedar admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the garden ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. Challenge issue is rate limited to 8 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole swarm at once. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
